headword: {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}

definitions.gloss: car insurance; automobile insurance; motor vehicle insurance
definitions.explanation: Insurance that covers damages, liability, and injuries related to motor vehicles. In Japan, this includes both mandatory government insurance and optional private insurance.

examples.japanese: {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧。
{自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't forget to renew your car insurance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Because I caused an accident, my car insurance premiums went up.

notes:
In Japan, car insurance is divided into two categories: {自賠責|じばいせき}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (compulsory automobile liability insurance, required by law) and ⟦{任意|にんい}→任意：16038_nini⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (optional/voluntary insurance, covering additional damages and liability beyond the mandatory minimum). Most drivers carry both.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧: to sign up for car insurance
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧: to renew car insurance
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧: car insurance premium
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{等級|とうきゅう}→等級：28928_toukyuu⟧: insurance grade/rating class

TYPES:
- {自賠責|じばいせき}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: compulsory liability insurance (legally required)
- ⟦{任意|にんい}→任意：16038_nini⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: voluntary insurance (recommended but not legally required)
- ⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: vehicle damage insurance (covers your own car)
- ⟦{対人|たいじん}→対人：28357_taijin⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: personal liability insurance
- {対物|たいぶつ}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: property damage insurance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}→生命保険：18637_seimeihoken⟧: life insurance — covers death and illness
- ⟦{火災|かさい}{保険|ほけん}→火災保険：20282_kasaihoken⟧: fire insurance — covers property damage from fire
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}{保険|ほけん}→損害保険：20874_songaihoken⟧: non-life insurance — broader category that includes car insurance
